id./param/scenario/cs/b_080_cs_130.pack|cs_: "Hah hah hah...! Where is the Luminary!? Hand over the Luminary!!
"Tch. So many... But I won't give the Luminary to such evil, twisted beings.
"Robert and I will hold here. You take {var:1} and flee the castle with Eleanor!
"Don't worry. I'm not so old that monsters like these will beat me. I'll follow later. Go!
"King Carnelian, Lord Robert... I leave this to you!"
